purpose: Select a declared retention action for supplied evidence metadata and expose authorization, legal-hold, requested-action, and no-match conditions without deleting anything.

inputs.evidence: category, sensitivity, age, seal state, and legal-hold metadata
inputs.rules: ordered explicit match, action, and authorized-role rules
inputs.requested_action: optional action to compare with policy

outputs.retention_decision: policy action, authorization state, overrides, and non-execution boundary
